rows.name: START.cmd launcher
rows.note: The front door: tools, projects, dev menu, local servers, prompts, Zen sessions and commit + push, all from one menu registry (launcher/vrg-menu.json).

rows.name: Local servers menu
rows.note: 17 helper servers with fixed ports (Planner 8131, Inventory 8123, MindMap 8124 …); a key starts one if it is down, then opens it.

rows.name: Commit + upload guard
rows.note: Commits the current branch and pushes it, never touches main on GitHub, never forces; secrets and files over 5 MB stop it. Q asks before leaving unpushed work.

rows.name: BACKUP menu
rows.note: Sync to H:\VRG\Backup with a SHA-256 manifest, git fsck, restore of one file or folder, installer check.

rows.name: Zen work sessions
rows.note: Opens tab groups in Zen: online workplace, main tools, tools in development, or all three.

rows.name: Prompt library

rows.name: Launcher check

rows.name: OTG menu

rows.name: lib/cloudattr.js
rows.note: cloudattr.js — OneDrive marks from one `attrib` run per listing (no shell). Any failure → no marks, never a blocked listing.

rows.name: lib/ctx.js
rows.note: ctx.js — "Csomag" (WP-22): VRG Stack node clusters as context packs, and "send to Claude" (API.md vrg.ctx).

rows.note: desk.js — the VRG Asztal's two primary views, as pure functions shared by main (CommonJS) and the frame page (window.VRGDeskLib).

rows.name: lib/fsops.js
rows.note: fsops.js — file operations as jobs (WP-12): copy, move, rename, mkdir, trash. Everything goes through handles and roots.

rows.name: lib/fsview.js
rows.note: fsview.js — look at a file and hand it to a program (WP-13): read, open, reveal, edit, copyPath. Handles in, display strings out.

rows.name: lib/git.js
rows.note: git.js — the Git panel's engine (WP-31, DESK-Q11 A): status, branches, worktrees, log, diff, a branch, a commit and a guarded push.

rows.name: lib/gmail.js
rows.note: gmail.js — read-only Gmail API client (WP-27). Tokens come from lib/oauth.js; nothing here stores or logs one.

rows.name: lib/handles.js
rows.note: handles.js — opaque file handles. The page only ever holds `h:` + 22 base64url chars issued here for this run.

rows.name: lib/innersearch.js
rows.note: innersearch.js — "Belső keresés" (WP-20): the VRG Stack (stack.js q) and the code index (tools/vrg-ctx.js q) in one answer.

rows.name: lib/ipc.js
rows.note: ipc.js — IPC v2: a schema-checked channel registry (API.md, CONTRACT §3). Every check fails closed.

rows.name: lib/jobs.js
rows.note: jobs.js — the one job queue in main (WP-09). Long work (copy, mail fetch, download) runs here, never in the page.

rows.name: lib/layout.js
rows.note: layout.js — the layout tree (API.md vrg.layout): pure functions, shared by main (CommonJS) and the frame page (classic script, window.VRGLayoutLib).

rows.name: lib/mail.js
rows.note: mail.js — the vrg.mail surface (WP-27, WP-28): Gmail API accounts (OAuth) and the webmail presets (WP-26, kind 'web') in one list.

rows.name: lib/mailclean.js
rows.note: mailclean.js — DESK-Q73 B (WP-35a): the mail HTML is cleaned in the page, with DOMPurify, before it is handed to the read view.

rows.name: lib/mime.js
rows.note: mime.js — a small RFC 5322 / 2045 parser for the mail client (WP-27). Pure: bytes in, plain object out.

rows.name: lib/names.js
rows.note: names.js — isSafeName: a basename the page may send for rename / new folder (CONTRACT §3). Same rule as ipc.js `name`.

rows.name: lib/notes.js
rows.note: notes.js — dev notes (WP-25): the one store is the Divergence outbox; tools/divergence.js `jot` writes it, Divergence's Push carries it.

rows.name: lib/oauth.js
rows.note: oauth.js — OAuth 2.0 for installed apps (RFC 8252): PKCE S256 (RFC 7636), a one-shot loopback redirect, the system browser (WP-27).

rows.name: lib/palette.js
rows.note: palette.js — the command palette (API.md vrg.layout.palette / run): the index of everything the Desktop can open, the matcher

rows.name: lib/paths.js
rows.note: paths.js — the only module that knows where personal state lives (CONTRACT §5).

rows.name: lib/ports.js
rows.note: ports.js — server ports probed on 127.0.0.1, starting and opening registry servers.

rows.name: lib/presets.js
rows.note: presets.js — presets and feeds (WP-29): a registry of named lookups (config/presets.json + <userDir>/presets.json) that run as jobs,

rows.name: lib/pty.js
rows.note: pty.js — the terminal manager (WP-14). Profiles come from config/profiles.json; the page only ever names a profile id,

rows.name: lib/quick.js
